entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:1
segments: Remember now your Creator in the days of your youth, while the evil days do not come, nor the years draw near, when you shall say, I have no pleasure in them.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:2
segments: So long as the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, are darkened, or the clouds return after rain,

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:3
segments: in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men, are bowed, and the grinders cease because there are few, and those who look out of the windows are darkened,

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:4
segments: and the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and you shall rise up at the voice of a bird, and all the daughters of music are silenced;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:5
segments: also they are afraid of the high place, and terrors along the way, and the almond tree shall blossom, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail; because man goes to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:6
segments: or ever the silver cord is not loosed, or the golden bowl is broken, or the pitcher is broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:7
segments: then the dust shall return to the earth as it was, and the spirit shall return to God who gave it.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:8
segments: Vanity of vanities, says the preacher; all [is] vanity.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:9
segments: And more than that, the preacher [was] wise; he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he listened, and looked, and set in order many proverbs.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:10
segments: The preacher sought to find out pleasing words; and words of truth written by the upright.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:11
segments: The words of the wise [are] like goads; yes, their collected words are like nails driven home; they [are] given from one Shepherd.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:12
segments: And further, by these, my son, be warned: The making of many books has no end, and much study [is] a weariness of the flesh.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:13
segments: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter. Fear God, and keep His commandments. For this [is] the whole [duty] of man.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:14
segments: For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether [it is] good, or whether evil.
